summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Next Day Disclosure Return on Form 6-K with the SEC, reporting ongoing share buybacks for cancellation under Hong Kong listing rules. The filing details 19 separate repurchases between March 20 and April 15, 2026, totaling over 12.5 million Class A ordinary shares at prices ranging from ~$6.57 to $7.14 per share. The repurchases represent up to ~0.078% of existing issued shares per date. The issuer, Kanzhun, is returning capital to shareholders via open-market repurchases. The shares have not yet been cancelled as of the closing balance date. Watch for continued buyback activity or potential acceleration as a sign of management's view on undervaluation.
